name: Sei Miko
source:
Level: 22

A holy woman who protected a forest town from the threat of demons.
She is not very good at fighting, but she has mastered a variety of holy magic.
She can heal the party's wounds and cure both poison and paralysis.

She is a full-bodied woman with breasts that can be squeezed.
She's not very athletic, and she's worried about her weight.

She joins the party, offering her innocence to the hero in exchange for his help in killing demons. She feels supreme pleasure in serving him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.caramel-box.com/products/geko-brave/character.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
